notes: This file is a hand-authored stand-in for facts a real ONNX graph parse
would extract (node op-type sequence per role, num_layers, dims). It is
NOT produced by parsing a real .onnx protobuf file and NOT extracted
'kv_cache_boundary' is a role marker the importer maps to llm.kv_cache_write
when emitting @qwen_prefill and llm.kv_cache_read when emitting @qwen_decode,
matching the existing raw attention pattern in mlir/raw_qwen_frontend_input.mlir.
Residual adds are intentionally omitted, consistent with the existing
raw_qwen_frontend_input.mlir fixture and this compiler's declared scope
(planning-relevant op/shape structure, not numerically real execution).
tools/export_qwen_onnx.py is intended to eventually replace this file with
facts extracted from a real ONNX export; see that script's module
